mapper.select: SELECT performance_round_id, performance_project_id, round_no, start_dttm, entry_start_dttm, reservation_open_dttm, reservation_close_dttm, status_code, created_dttm, updated_dttm FROM performance_round WHERE performance_round_id = #{performanceRoundId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT performance_round_accessibility_id, performance_round_id, support_type_code, title, description, display_order, created_dttm, updated_dttm FROM performance_round_accessibility WHERE performance_round_accessibility_id = #{performanceRoundAccessibilityId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT performance_round_id, performance_project_id, round_no, start_dttm, entry_start_dttm, reservation_open_dttm, reservation_close_dttm, status_code FROM performance_round WHERE performance_project_id = #{performanceProjectId} ORDER BY start_dttm, round_no, performance_round_id

SELECT performance_round_accessibility_id, performance_round_id, support_type_code, title, description, display_order FROM performance_round_accessibility WHERE performance_round_id = #{performanceRoundId} ORDER BY display_order, performance_round_accessibility_id

SELECT pra.performance_round_accessibility_id, pra.performance_round_id, pra.support_type_code, pra.title, pra.description, pra.display_order FROM performance_round_accessibility pra JOIN performance_round pr ON pr.performance_round_id = pra.performance_round_id WHERE pr.performance_project_id = #{performanceProjectId} ORDER BY pr.start_dttm, pr.round_no, pra.display_order, pra.performance_round_accessibility_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO performance_round ( performance_project_id, round_no, start_dttm, entry_start_dttm, reservation_open_dttm, reservation_close_dttm, status_code ) VALUES ( #{performanceProjectId}, #{roundNo}, #{startDttm}, #{entryStartDttm}, #{reservationOpenDttm}, #{reservationCloseDttm}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE performance_round SET round_no = #{roundNo}, start_dttm = #{startDttm}, entry_start_dttm = #{entryStartDttm}, reservation_open_dttm = #{reservationOpenDttm}, reservation_close_dttm = #{reservationCloseDttm}, status_code = #{status} WHERE performance_round_id = #{performanceRoundId}

UPDATE performance_round_accessibility SET support_type_code = #{supportType}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, display_order = #{displayOrder} WHERE performance_round_accessibility_id = #{performanceRoundAccessibilityId}
